    calculator.endDateTime = notificationDueTime;
    calculator.calcScheduleDuration();

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="cmn_relative_duration"><cmn_relative_duration action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><name>REG Ransomware / SOCI Initial SLA</name><script><![CDATA[// Perform relative duration calculation using the 'calculator' variable (which is a DurationCalculator object)

(function() {

	//Confirm if the base table is task or task_sla
	var taskRecord;
	var tableName = current.getTableName();
	var baseTableName = GlideDBObjectManager.getAbsoluteBase(tableName);

	if (baseTableName == "task") {
		taskRecord = current;
	} else if (baseTableName == "task_sla") {
		taskRecord = current.task;
	}

	// Confirm the notification type, retrieve the corresponding SLA time and confirm the correct field to calculate SLA start time
	var notificationType = taskRecord.getValue('notification_type');
	var slaTime;
	var clockStart;
	if (notificationType === 'asd_soci_notification') {
		if (taskRecord.getValue('soci_classification') === 'significant') {
			slaTime = 'x_1776078_cyber_0.sla.soci_significant_initial_hours';
		}
		else {
			slaTime = 'x_1776078_cyber_0.sla.soci_relevant_initial_hours';
		}
		clockStart = (baseTableName == "task")
			? current.getElement("parent_cyber_incident.date_time_became_aware")
			: current.getElement("task.parent_cyber_incident.date_time_became_aware");
	}
	if (notificationType === 'ransomware_payment_report') {
		slaTime = 'x_1776078_cyber_0.sla.ransomware_report_hours';
		clockStart = (baseTableName == "task")
			? current.getElement("parent_cyber_incident.payment_date_time")
			: current.getElement("task.parent_cyber_incident.payment_date_time");
	}

    //add application system property for ransomware onto the payment date time
    var ransomwareSLA = Number(gs.getProperty(slaTime)) * 3600;
    var notificationDueTime = new GlideDateTime(clockStart.getGlideObject());
    notificationDueTime.addSeconds(ransomwareSLA);

    // if we've got a "breach date" and it's already breached, set the "breach date" to 1 second in the future
	var slaCreated = new GlideDateTime(calculator.startDateTime);
    if (notificationDueTime.before(slaCreated)) {
        slaCreated.addSeconds(1);
		notificationDueTime = slaCreated;
    }

    // set the endDateTime property of the calculator object
    calculator.endDateTime = notificationDueTime;
    calculator.calcScheduleDuration();
})();]]></script><sys_class_name>cmn_relative_duration</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-08-11 11:56:46</sys_created_on><sys_id>401b694b836acf1044779cb6feaad3fe</sys_id><sys_mod_count>35</sys_mod_count><sys_name>REG Ransomware / SOCI Initial SLA</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Cyber Incident Management" source="x_1776078_cyber_0">9c0eda15c31d03102d84f44ed4013148</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Cyber Incident Management">9c0eda15c31d03102d84f44ed4013148</sys_scope><sys_update_name>cmn_relative_duration_401b694b836acf1044779cb6feaad3fe</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-08-27 10:11:54</sys_updated_on></cmn_relative_duration></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="cmn_relative_duration"><cmn_relative_duration action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><name>SOCI Follow Up SLA</name><script><![CDATA[// Perform relative duration calculation using the 'calculator' variable (which is a DurationCalculator object)

(function() {

	//Confirm if the base table is task or task_sla
	var taskRecord;
	var tableName = current.getTableName();
	var baseTableName = GlideDBObjectManager.getAbsoluteBase(tableName);

	if (baseTableName == "task") {
		taskRecord = current;
	} else if (baseTableName == "task_sla") {
		taskRecord = current.task;
	}

	// Retrieve the corresponding SLA time
	var slaTime;
	if (taskRecord.getValue('soci_classification') === 'significant') {
		slaTime = 'x_1776078_cyber_0.sla.soci_significant_written_hours';
	}
	else {
		slaTime = 'x_1776078_cyber_0.sla.soci_relevant_written_hours';
	}

	// Find the moment State became "Oral Notification Complete"
	var oralCompleteTime;
	var audit = new GlideRecord('sys_audit');
	audit.addQuery('tablename', taskRecord.getTableName());
	audit.addQuery('documentkey', taskRecord.getUniqueValue());
	audit.addQuery('fieldname', 'state');
	audit.addQuery('newvalue', '5');  // confirm this is the correct value for Oral Notification Complete
	audit.orderBy('sys_created_on');
	audit.setLimit(1);
	audit.query();

	if (audit.next()) {
		oralCompleteTime = new GlideDateTime(audit.getValue('sys_created_on'));
	} else {
		oralCompleteTime = new GlideDateTime(calculator.startDateTime); // fallback, shouldn't normally hit this
	}

    //calculate when the notification due date time is
    var durationSeconds = Number(gs.getProperty(slaTime)) * 3600;
    var notificationDueTime = new GlideDateTime(oralCompleteTime);
    notificationDueTime.addSeconds(durationSeconds);

    // set the endDateTime property of the calculator object
    calculator.endDateTime = notificationDueTime;
    calculator.calcScheduleDuration();
})();]]></script><sys_class_name>cmn_relative_duration</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-08-27 10:43:52</sys_created_on><sys_id>508c73c083038f1044779cb6feaad3ac</sys_id><sys_mod_count>2</sys_mod_count><sys_name>SOCI Follow Up SLA</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Cyber Incident Management" source="x_1776078_cyber_0">9c0eda15c31d03102d84f44ed4013148</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Cyber Incident Management">9c0eda15c31d03102d84f44ed4013148</sys_scope><sys_update_name>cmn_relative_duration_508c73c083038f1044779cb6feaad3ac</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-08-27 11:12:36</sys_updated_on></cmn_relative_duration></record_update>
